d: 'Mitwa' from 'Kabhi Alvida Na Kehna' also called KANK is a beautiful dance track and you'll automatically start dancing on its tune. It features the voices of Shafqat Amanat Ali, Shankar Mahadevan and Caralisa Monteiro. The movie's music is directed by Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy. The starcast consists of Rani Mukherjee Shah Rukh Khan, the King of Bollywood, Abhishek Bachchan, Preity Zinta, Kirron Kher and Amitabh Bachchan, while Arjun Rampal does a guest appearance.
